The score · संगीत

Sound is the first language.
We compose in three.

Before the picture cuts, before the actor breathes — the audience is already being conducted, by frequency. Music sets the soul. Sound sculpts the body. Dialogue carves the meaning. We engineer each layer at the level of physiology: tones that settle the vagus nerve, transients that shock the spine, silences the room steps inside. The craft is not in adding sound. It is in choosing which frequencies to leave inside the listener.

०१
Music
The emotional elixir. Bespoke scores tuned to breath, heart-rate and exhale — written before the edit locks.
०२
Sound
Foley, design, texture — the skin the picture wears. Sub-bass shudder to silver shimmer.
०३
Dialogue
Voice as instrument. Cadence, breath, intimacy ADR — closer than the lens dares go.
The craft

A hybrid studio.
Camera and code — one tribe.

We come from traditional filmmaking — sets, lenses, actors — and we fold AI into every stage where it buys control and kills waste: pre-vis, VFX, b-roll, motion capture, enhancement. Live action when the story demands skin and sweat. AI when it demands the impossible. The craft of storytelling decides; the tools obey.
